rationale: Price is sitting exactly at today's low with only one 1-minute candle of data, volume is well below average (0.57x relative volume), and the ATR is extremely tight at $0.1175 — offering insufficient range for a meaningful risk/reward setup in either direction. The spread of ~12 bps relative to the ATR makes entry costs prohibitive, and there is no established intraday structure (no swing highs/lows, no trend) to anchor a directional thesis. Conditions favor waiting for price discovery and volume to develop before committing capital.
